primary_api_or_format: Protocol Designer JSON (exportable to Python for OT-2)

tools.name: opentrons_simulate (CLI)
tools.notes: Offline simulator; executes protocol logic, prints command log, and catches many runtime errors (labware/pipette compatibility, volume bounds, etc.).

tools.name: Opentrons App — Protocol Analysis
tools.notes: Analyzes protocols on upload; verifies required labware, pipettes, modules, and tip usage; surfaces errors and warnings before any run.

tools.name: Protocol Designer (web app)
tools.notes: Visual builder for OT-2. Provides step previews and deck validation and can export ready-to-run protocols.

tools.name: opentrons.simulate (Python API)
tools.notes: Programmatic simulation within Python (useful for CI/unit tests). Returns command logs and surfaces errors without hardware.

tools.name: Labware Creator
tools.notes: Create and validate custom labware JSON definitions to ensure compatibility during simulation and analysis.

static_checking.notes: No robot-specific static type checker exists. Use opentrons_simulate and Opentrons App analysis for pre-run validation; general Python linters/type checkers help with syntax/types but not robot semantics.

recommendation: Design or implement the serial dilution protocol using Protocol Designer or the Opentrons Protocol API v2, then validate via opentrons_simulate and Opentrons App analysis before running on hardware.
